coverImageAlt: A navy hand press transforms a cyan clay form into a bound stack of blank structured paper sheets.
coverImagePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: AI.Tedt.org artifact gallery cover
Artifact kind: Prompt Template File
Primary request: A compact bookbinding press transforming one amorphous idea form into a clean stack of structured blank blueprint sheets, expressing conversational collection and generation of a complete product requirements document.
Scene/backdrop: Minimal warm-paper workshop surface against deep slate, with only the press and its transformation path visible.
Subject: One dominant navy mechanical press; a soft irregular cyan clay form enters one side and emerges as several aligned warm-paper sheets with varied cutout sections and one orange binding thread, all free of marks.
Style/medium: premium editorial illustration with tactile dimensional detail; hand-built printing press, molded paper, bookbinding cloth, and restrained mechanical realism.
Composition/framing: exact 16:10 landscape; low three-quarter view with a bold press silhouette; input and output remain large and legible at approximately 290-pixel card width; crop-safe focal subject; no essential detail in the outer 8%.
Lighting/mood: calm, capable, quietly technical; soft cyan backlight and a single orange thread accent.
Color palette: warm paper #F8F6F0, slate #101820, navy #00446F, cyan #00A9E0, sparing orange #E86027.
Materials/textures: brushed painted metal, deckled paper edges, book cloth, matte clay, subtle workshop wear.
Constraints: original image; one dominant metaphor; every sheet must be completely blank and unmarked; no text, pseudo-writing, letters, numbers, product UI, vendor logos, trademarks, watermarks, paws, paw imagery, cats, cat silhouettes, or Microsoft Fluent styling.
Avoid: type blocks, printing letters, readable diagrams, screen interfaces, factory clutter, generic chatbot imagery, glowing brains, Microsoft-like color gradients.
Targeted correction: Pull the camera back and reduce the whole press assembly so the clay input tray, every edge of the press, and the complete bound sheet stack all fit inside the inner 84% of the frame with a clear slate-and-paper border; preserve the same text-free clay-to-structured-sheets transformation.
